events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $4.33 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
The trip is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra kilometres enter the fare directly [F6][RD-2]; the app quote (21.2 km) is not binding but the driver's RD-1 duty to take the shortest and most direct route is [F1][RD-1]. One off-route segment exists: 09:24–09:30, 3.78 km driven where the optimal route covers 0.71 km, adding 3.07 km [F3], and the trace settles that no RD-4 incident excuses it [F13][RD-4].

The remaining questions are RD-3 and RD-5. The chat record is complete and every message is timestamped [F9]; it contains only a pickup greeting and the driver's car description [F7][F8]. No rider message before 09:24:50 asks for a stop or names any place or road, so there is no rider-agreed route the segment could fall under [F7][F8][RD-5], and no rider-named stop for RD-3(a) to exempt [RD-3]. The driver's post-trip statement that "the GPS sent me; it rerouted" is a claim in his own statement, not rider consent, and does not excuse the deviation [F10][RD-5]. The segment therefore counts in full under RD-2 [F3][RD-2].

Amount: the fare record gives this trip's rate as distance fare ÷ distance km = $34.42 ÷ 24.41 km = $1.4101/km [F4][F6][RD-2]. The segment's extra distance is 3.07 km [F3]; 3.07 km × $1.4101/km = $4.3290, so $4.33. The trace note of $3.20 km × $1.4101 = $4.51 [F4] is the whole-trip excess, which includes non-segment mileage (corridor return trips, map-matching jitter) that RD-2 does not refund; only the measured off-route segment is refundable.

On the driver's profile: 1 upheld dispute in 90 days, but it is a no-show case and route disputes upheld = 0 [F16], so the "repeated" condition of RD-6 is not met and no account flag is raised [RD-6]. The rider's profile (0 upheld disputes) is not used to decide the case [F15]. Refund is via Ryde voucher per NS-7 [NS-7].

Safety screen: I read the complaint, both chat messages and the driver's statement in context — no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation appears [F7][F8][F10]; the complaint alleges only silent rerouting and extra distance [F1][F3]. Safety_concern: none [SAFE-1].

Please keep to the shortest direct route on future trips.
